title: Image manifest (manifest.csv) — column spec (v0)
description: manifest.csv is a flat row-per-image table at the bundle root. Used as a publish/validation artifact, not consumed by the app's main loader. Column order MUST match this spec. Encoding is UTF-8, no BOM, comma-delimited, RFC-4180 quoting.

x-column-spec.filename: e.g. stop-01-hero-01.jpg — matches /images/<filename> in the bundle.
x-column-spec.title_en: English title from the publish; CA/ES variants in locales/.
x-column-spec.long_description_en: English long description (optional, may be empty).
x-column-spec.credit_line: Single-line attribution string the app displays verbatim.
x-column-spec.author_creator: Person or institution credited as author.
x-column-spec.original_date: Year or date string as published by the source (e.g. '1926', 'c.1880').
x-column-spec.source_format: Original format before normalize (jpg|jpeg|png|gif). For traceability.
